system.description:
You quickly mold your chakra, creating multiple layers of armor from it and raising your guard to nullify damage at the exact moment it would affect you. You gain 3 Royal Shield, charges which can only be spent when you take damage until the beginning of your next turn.

Until the start of your next turn, each time you would take damage, you can spend any number of Royal Shield charges you have remaining to reduce the damage taken by 6. If you reduce the damage taken to 0 you ignore the attack, ability or jutsu’s effects.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of Royal Shield charges you gain by +1 . If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can spend 2 of your remaining Royal Shield charges to release the pent-up kinetic energy you’ve deflected, making a melee taijutsu attack against the most recent triggering creature so long as they are within 20 feet of you. On a hit, you deal [Unarmed damage] + 2d6 for every Royal Shield charge spent since this jutsu’s casting. Regardless of a hit or miss, after this attack you lose all remaining Royal Shield charges. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank you can release pent up kinetic energy in a shockwave around you. All creatures of your choice within a 20-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Unarmed damage] + 2d10 for every Royal Shield charge you have remaining on a failed save, or half as much damage on a success. You lose all remaining Royal Shield charges after using this effect.
